title: Synthetic implementation-evidence lifecycle demonstration
purpose: Demonstrate source-grounded pairwise comparison across three clearly differentiated fictional implementation stages

criteria.name: Demonstrated implementation and integration evidence
criteria.rubric: Compare current, source-described implementation evidence only. A running prototype with a tested implementation and completed examples using sample applications demonstrates more current integration evidence than interface examples or speculative reuse; a running, tested prototype demonstrates more implementation evidence than a design proposal with no runnable code; a design proposal demonstrates more than a concept without architecture or milestones. Count completed examples, not predicted adoption. Do not infer unpublished evidence or reward future potential.
